stem.en: A flag is raised to the top of a pole with a pulley. Then it is raised again, twice as fast. What changes?

text.en: The work and the power both double.
Neither the work nor the power changes.

explanation.en: The work is the flag's weight x the height of the pole, which does not change. Raising it twice as fast halves the time. Power = work / time, so the power doubles.

hints.en: Does the speed of raising change the weight or the height?
What happens to work / time when the time is halved?
